summary: The recent-place popup adds typed and pasted first-line query filtering, live activity and attention labels, and enhanced Ctrl+Tab cycling with observed Control-release commit and explicit-popup fallback.

compatibility.detail: Enhanced Ctrl+Tab cycles recent places; modifier-release commit activates only after real Control release events are observed, otherwise Enter commits. Typing or pasting filters the popup and switches to explicit commit. Attached Ctrl+^ and Ctrl+Tab remain program input. Tabs retain quiet brackets and Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown.
